title: Update or commit project documents by VCS status
summary: Reads the version control status of each project document through IVcsManager and IVcsProject, and updates out-of-date documents or commits modified ones, as a dry run by default.
phrasings: check the SVN or Git status of project files
commit modified project documents from an extension
is my project under version control
update out-of-date documents from the repository

commands.name: GetProjectVcsStatus
commands.description: Report the VCS status of the focused project's documents (read-only)

commands.name: SyncProjectVcs
commands.description: Update out-of-date and commit modified documents (dry run by default)
